```{r setup}
library(tidyverse)
library(dplyr)
library(jsonlite)
```

```{r preprocessing monthly}
m <-read_csv("../public/master_monthly.csv")

# Remove unnecessary columns 
m <- select(m, -snapshot_chart_date, -monthly_rank, -source_row_index, -source_chart_index,
 -musicbrainz_match_status, -weekly_observation_count, -snapshot_months_selected,
 -reported_last_week_rank, 
 -mb_recording_count, -mb_release_count, -mb_release_date_precision, -mb_release_title, 
 -mb_duration_median_seconds, -mb_duration_min_seconds, -mb_duration_max_seconds,
 -total_chart_points,- mb_distinct_duration_count, -in_final_study_population, -lyrics_status)

# set lyric lens flags to 0 or 1 
m <- m %>%
  mutate(across(starts_with("ll_"), ~ ifelse(. > 0.5, 1, 0)))

# Change all earliest release dates to year for consistency 
m$mb_earliest_release_date <- 
  as.integer(substr(as.character(m$mb_earliest_release_date), 1, 4))

# Remove low confidence genre rows
m <- m  %>% filter(genre_confidence != "low")

# Merge "Afrobeats / African Pop" genre with "Other" due to low frequency (13 distinct songs in primary_genre)
m <- m %>%
  mutate(primary_genre = if_else
  (primary_genre == "Afrobeats / African Pop", "Other", primary_genre))

m <- m %>%
  mutate(secondary_genres = str_replace_all(secondary_genres,
  fixed("Afrobeats / African Pop"), "Other"))

# Remove duplicate song entries
m_no_duplicates <- m[!duplicated(m$song_id), ]
m <- select(m,-song_id)
m_no_duplicates <- select(m_no_duplicates,-song_id)

# Remove rows that are missing lyrics
m_lyrics_available <- m_no_duplicates  %>% filter(lyrics_available != 0)

write_csv(m, "monthly.csv")
write_csv(m, "monthly_no_duplicates.csv")
write_csv(m, "monthly_lyrics_available.csv")
```

```{r preprocessing weekly}
w <-read_csv("../public/master_weekly.csv.xz")

# Remove unnecessary columns 
w <- select(w, -weekly_rank, -source_row_index, -source_chart_index, -weekly_observation_count,
 -musicbrainz_match_status, -reported_last_week_rank, -first_snapshot_month,
 -last_snapshot_month, -snapshot_months_selected,  -reported_weeks_on_chart,
 -mb_recording_count, -mb_release_count, -mb_release_date_precision, -mb_release_title, 
 -mb_duration_median_seconds, -mb_duration_min_seconds, -mb_duration_max_seconds,
 -total_chart_points,- mb_distinct_duration_count, -lyrics_status)

# set lyric lens flags to 0 or 1 
w <- w %>%
  mutate(across(starts_with("ll_"), ~ ifelse(. > 0.5, 1, 0)))

w$mb_earliest_release_date <- 
  as.integer(substr(as.character(w$mb_earliest_release_date), 1, 4))

# Remove genre labels from rows with low confidence
w <- w %>%
  mutate(primary_genre = if_else(genre_confidence == "low", NA_character_, primary_genre))

w <- w %>%
  mutate(secondary_genres = if_else(genre_confidence == "low", NA_character_, secondary_genres))

# Merge "Afrobeats / African Pop" genre with "Other" due to low frequency
w <- w %>%
  mutate(primary_genre = if_else(primary_genre == "Afrobeats / African Pop", "Other", primary_genre))

w <- w %>%
  mutate(secondary_genres = str_replace_all(secondary_genres,
  fixed("Afrobeats / African Pop"), "Other"))

# Remove duplicate song entries
w_no_duplicates <- w[!duplicated(w$song_id), ]

w <- select(w,-song_id)
w_no_duplicates <- select(w_no_duplicates,-song_id)

write_csv(w, "weekly.csv.xz")
write_csv(w_no_duplicates, "weekly_no_duplicates.csv")
```
